vocabulary.en: A place where bees are kept; a collection of beehives.
vocabulary.ex: "Bees Neez Apiaries" — the name of the business.

vocabulary.en: The process of removing or obtaining something from a source.

vocabulary.vi: tổ ong, sáp ong chứa mật
vocabulary.en: A structure of hexagonal wax cells built by bees to store honey.
A natural wax produced by honey bees, used in candles and cosmetics.
A fine powder produced by flowers, collected by bees as food.
A nutritious substance produced by bees, fed to larvae and the queen bee.
A resinous substance collected by bees from tree buds, used to seal gaps in the hive.
Honey that has been processed to control crystallization, giving it a smooth, spreadable texture.
An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time and place.
A shop selling items suitable as gifts, often at tourist attractions.
An arrangement to have something (such as a seat or room) kept for you.
To try a small amount of something to see what it is like.
To make a journey visiting several places of interest.
A factory or place where an industrial process takes place.

vocabulary.vi: được chào đón, được hoan nghênh

ieltsQuestions.t: The gift shop is open every day from 10am to 4pm.
ieltsQuestions.vi: Sai — cửa hàng mở cửa mỗi Chủ nhật, không phải mỗi ngày. "Gift shop open every Sunday 10am–4pm."
ieltsQuestions.en: FALSE — The shop is open every Sunday, not every day.

ieltsQuestions.t: The gift shop sells products which are produced at this apiary.
ieltsQuestions.vi: Đúng — quảng cáo nói "Sample different types of honey; tour the extraction plant" — mật ong được sản xuất tại đây.
ieltsQuestions.en: TRUE — The ad says you can sample honey and tour the extraction plant, showing products are made on-site.

ieltsQuestions.t: Tourists can try their hand at making candles.
ieltsQuestions.vi: Không có thông tin — quảng cáo chỉ bán nến sáp ong, không đề cập đến việc du khách tự làm nến.
ieltsQuestions.en: NOT GIVEN — Beeswax candles are sold, but there's no mention of visitors making them.

ieltsQuestions.t: Appointments can be made by phone or online.
ieltsQuestions.vi: Không có thông tin — chỉ có số điện thoại và trang web, nhưng không nói rõ có thể đặt hẹn qua mạng.
ieltsQuestions.en: NOT GIVEN — A phone number and website are listed, but the ad doesn't state how appointments are made.

ieltsQuestions.t: The gift shop is within the grounds of a farm.
ieltsQuestions.vi: Không có thông tin — đây là trại nuôi ong (apiary), không đề cập đến trang trại (farm).
ieltsQuestions.en: NOT GIVEN — It's an apiary (bee farm), but the ad doesn't mention it being on a farm.

usefulPhrases.example: The campsite is located between the towns of Oxford and Reading.

active.name: True / False / Not Given
active.description: You are given statements and must decide if they agree with the information in the text (TRUE), contradict it (FALSE), or if there is no information about this (NOT GIVEN). Tests your ability to identify specific details and distinguish between what is stated, what is contradicted, and what is simply not mentioned.
tips: Read the statement carefully — look for absolute words like 'every', 'all', 'only', 'always'
TRUE means the text says exactly this (maybe in different words)
FALSE means the text says the opposite or something clearly different
NOT GIVEN means the text doesn't mention this at all — don't use your own knowledge
Be careful with partial matches — if only part of the statement is confirmed, it may be FALSE or NOT GIVEN
active.vi: Bạn được cho các phát biểu và phải quyết định chúng đúng (TRUE), sai (FALSE), hay không có thông tin (NOT GIVEN) so với bài đọc. Kiểm tra khả năng phân biệt giữa thông tin được nêu, bị mâu thuẫn, và không được đề cập.
